title: Trajectoire : la robotisation des industries / Trajectory: the robotisation of industry
license: Droits réservés — deposit of the Union des entreprises de l'Indre, Ciclic Mémoire; no open licence
notes: France (Centre-Val de Loire), French, 1988: a regional industrial TV magazine on Umatic SP, the print marked 'film très abîmé' by the archive. Windows: the hand-drawn 'Trajectoires' title over a grid horizon and a warped glass building; a green-line CAD plan on a monitor (40-1, 40-2); Bernadette Dominguez, robot operator at Tubauto, on how her job changed; LONG — the Nouvelle République press room in Tours, the claviste Gérard Sarthon at a terminal, green 'ENTREE DE TEXTE' on screen, hands on the keyboard, page proofs; the Flonic Schlumberger foundry robots at Châteauroux handling castings; a Paco Rabanne rotary bottling line. Fetched from Ciclic Mémoire's HLS (memoire.ciclic.fr embed 5310).
